notes: Two English that-words stand in the verse. The first introduces the temporal clause and goes to the infinitive construct as the rectum of מִיּוֹם, since the preposition and the construct noun each already hold a word of their own (rule 52); the second stands at the head of the apodosis and is carried by that clause's own waw (rule 45), leaving the הָיָה frame with it came to pass alone.
The waw of וַיִּהְיוּ is rendered for, which rule 14's open list admits.
